dimensions.assessment: Applies to individuals on public property in the District of Columbia.
dimensions.evidence: Any person who, without lawful authority, engages in camping outdoors on public property in the District of Columbia

dimensions.assessment: Imposes potential fines of up to $500, imprisonment for up to 30 days, or both for violators.
dimensions.evidence: shall be fined not more than $500, imprisoned for not more than 30 days, or both.

dimensions.assessment: Potential fine revenue is negligible; no specific federal appropriations or spending changes are mentioned.
Amends local criminal code provisions for the District of Columbia regarding public camping.
dimensions.evidence: Section 824 of the Act to establish a code of law for the District of Columbia... is amended

dimensions.assessment: Establishes a permanent statutory prohibition in the District of Columbia code.
dimensions.evidence: To prohibit camping on public property in the District of Columbia.

importance_detail.rationale: Prohibits camping outdoors on public property in the District of Columbia and establishes penalties for violations.
